title: The Second Decree: The Jews Are Granted the Right to Defend Themselves
description:
The king's scribes issue a new decree in the name of King Ahasuerus that gives the Jews in every city the right to gather and defend themselves against attackers on the thirteenth day of the month Adar.  
Heralds riding swift royal horses spread the message to all the provinces from India to Cush.  
Mordecai goes out from the king wearing royal garments of blue and white cloth, with a large gold crown and a robe of fine linen and purple, and the city of Susa rejoices.  
For the Jews there is light, joy, gladness, and honor, and many of the people of the land convert to Judaism because they fear them.
